summary.caption: A centered, near-symmetrical epic fantasy vista at dawn, shot from a low worm's-eye vantage on a 21mm wide-angle lens: a monumental luminous world-tree and white marble citadel rise dead center and nearly fill the frame, their vertical masses converging dramatically toward the top edge. A long stone causeway with tiny cloaked pilgrims begins at the bottom edge and leads the eye straight to the citadel gate in strong one-point perspective. A hidden sun behind the canopy backlights everything: volumetric light shafts spill through the branches, rim-lighting every edge, while drifting mist separates the depth planes. Cool teal shadows against pale gold highlights, restrained cinematic grading, deep focus f/16, fine grain, gentle vignette, overwhelming monumental scale. Balanced but not flat: natural floating rock islands and cascading waterfalls frame both sides, layered cloud sea and distant peaks recede into violet-blue aerial perspective. STRUCTURE RULE: the centered citadel is the ONLY building in the entire image, made of a few large readable blocky volumes with broad facades, big arched windows and strong horizontal bands, never a forest of thin needle spires. All distant islands are pure natural rock, water and trees, simplified into broad low-contrast hazy silhouettes with no towers, no columns, no ruins and no fine detail. No text, no watermark, no logos.

items.label: object
items.caption: Dead center, filling almost the full frame height: a colossal ancient world-tree with luminous turquoise foliage, its exposed roots cradling ONE clearly readable white-marble citadel. Its architecture is a few big solid volumes: one dominant broad central tower with a pyramidal crown, four massive square corner towers with wide facades, rows of large arched windows and heavy horizontal terrace bands. Readable blocky masses and calm horizontal lines, NOT needle-like pinnacles or dense thin vertical rods. Strong backlight gives a brilliant rim along every edge; the canopy breaks the top of the frame, conveying overwhelming scale. Symmetrical, with no tiny repeated spikes.

items.label: object
items.caption: Bottom center foreground: a long narrow stone causeway with a few large weathered arches receding toward the citadel gate in strict one-point perspective, its converging lines forming a powerful leading line. Two minuscule cloaked pilgrims with staffs walk along it, tiny against the architecture. Dark warm stone in the near field, gradually veiled by low mist toward the far end. Simple heavy masonry, no tiny decorative posts or thin pillars.

items.label: object
items.caption: Upper left: a low broad flat-topped natural rock island with one wide waterfall spilling from its edge and a few windswept trees, cool blue low-contrast aerial perspective. Pure geology and water, NO buildings, NO towers, NO spires, NO ruins, NO thin vertical structures. Simplified flat silhouette framing the central mass without competing with it.

items.label: object
items.caption: Upper right: a matching low broad natural rock island with one wide waterfall and layered snow peaks behind, pale violet-blue haze. Pure natural landscape with NO architecture of any kind, no needle spires, no thin rods, reduced to a broad hazy shape, mirroring the left side to hold the symmetry.

items.label: object
items.caption: Several tiny long-winged dragons gliding high across the canopy, backlit dark silhouettes with warm edge glow, deliberately small to reinforce the monumental scale.

items.label: object
items.caption: A soft hidden sun disc directly behind the tree canopy, its light bursting through the leaves as volumetric shafts, the brightest point of the frame with gentle golden bloom.
